¶2.
** The Divine
 ordering power proceeded forth to establish a new
 state of the

 of the

 to
 receive wisdom
 and love in

 not

**¶3.** The
 containing forms of doctrine — vessels capable
 of bearing

,
 carrying
 what

 wisdom
 through

 of heaven
.

**¶4.**
 The turning
 progress
ions of divine influx began to transm
it spiritual life both
 down
ward into the natural mind and in
ward toward
 the higher
 degrees of understanding —
 so
 that no
 plane
 of the human
 spirit
 was
 left without
 the circulation
 of good
 and truth con
joined.

enly doctrine could flow forth

ated.

**
 Corresponding openings were also laid
 bare

ities and spent evils that must

 The concentrated

rium was separated from the ruling affections

 States

ation — so that the understanding could perce
ive what

ound
 them

 Spiritual conceptions that could not come
 to mat
urity —

formed or

 birth
 — fell into the outermost natural

 where they remain

ren things

 of regener
ation.

**¶11.
** The successive passages of spiritual life through
 changing states and forms —
 the movement
 of

ections and

 into
 another — began to take place within the
 intermediate degrees of the mind,
 which
 stand
 between what
 is celestial above
 and what is merely
 natural below.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
The sixth is the doors too [of the ships, the ones upon the lower side, that they were opened to receive the waste.]
The seventh is [the Sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.

The fifth is the
 doors of the ships, that they were
 opened up [to send the refined light
 to the new aeon.]

The eighth: Night and
 day were separated [so that darkness should
 no longer be confounded with the light
.]
